params.prompt:
1950s theatrical cartoon slapstick, hand-drawn colored-pencil pencil-test animation on cream paper, held on twos with visible line boil. Fixed camera, locked tripod, one continuous shot.

The index finger resting beside the big SHIP key lifts off the keyboard, hovers over the big key for a beat, and comes down onto it, pressing the key down into the keyboard with one clean firm push; the key sinks and stays sunk under the fingertip. The finger holds it down, still. Then the finger presses it once more, a small extra push, and holds it down.

The big key reads SHIP in every frame. The small keys around it stay blank rectangles in the same places in every frame. There is exactly one hand with five fingers in every frame, and it stays at the lower right of the frame in every frame. The keyboard stays on the same spot on the wooden desk top in every frame.

Squash and stretch on every accent, smear frames through the fast arcs, snappy timing, elastic overshoot, comic energy.
